param.name: cluster_radius
param.label: Approximate size in voxel of the objects to cluster. 5 is a good value for events of 400nm on films with a pixel size of 160nm.
param.help: Approximate size in voxel of the objects to cluster. 5 is a good value for events of 400nm on films with a pixel size of 160nm.

param.name: keep_labels_unchanged
param.label: By default, bright spots are removed (labels 1 are set to 0) and exocytose events (labels 2) are set to 1. This option skip this step, so labels are kept unchanged.
param.help: By default, bright spots are removed (labels 1 are set to 0) and exocytose events (labels 2) are set to 1. This option skip this step, so labels are kept unchanged.
